requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4452-5400--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2363-4659-5224-6967.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Honest Rutstein, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3845-4279-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3845-4279-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

529-7297-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1531-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2486-4694-4779-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-4779-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving it +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

719-2292-3413.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

628-2292-7865.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-6260.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Innkeeper's Talent and Caradora.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Pia and Kiran Nalaar

457-1156-1409.description:
Activate Pia and Kiran Nalaar by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Pia and Kiran Nalaar enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Pia and Kiran Nalaar
Resolve the Pia and Kiran Nalaar trigger, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two artifacts, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

907-1558-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

632-3621-4659-4742-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4659-4742-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2308-2741-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-2741-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Essence Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4681-5170-6273.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-4885.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

856-1379-2034-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3191-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
3191-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Kairi and of the four mana-producing permanents.
Put all Kairi tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering each token once.
Resolve the first Kairi trigger, causing you to mill six cards and return Doppelgang from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Kairi triggers, choosing either mode as desired.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
3191-5352.notes: Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

2034-3490-4716-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-4716-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Prosperous Innkeeper indestructible.
2034-3490-4716-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1025-5302.notablePrerequisites:
Keeper of the Nine Gales does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional Birds.
1025-5302.description:
Stasis causes your opponents to skip their untap steps.
During the opponent's turn prior to yours, after the untap step would occur, activate Keeper of the Nine Gales by tapping it and two other Birds you control, returning Stasis from the battlefield to your hand.
During your turn, cast Stasis by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat.

101-4050-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Vampire Charmseeker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker, adding {B}.
When Vampire Charmseeker dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

396-1308-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-1308-1409-4050.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1651-2645-3094-4131-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
1651-2645-3094-4131-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1455-1744-2523.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Adrix and Nev.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev.
Resolve Rite of Replication, creating eight copies of Adrix and Nev.
Put all but one legendary Adrix and Nev into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Adrix and Nevs die, Ratadrabik triggers eight times.
Resolve the first Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you currently control) that are 2/2 Zombies in addition to their other types.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
